snippet.title: JETRUNNER | Official Gameplay & Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST JETRUNNER ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865670/JETRUNNER/

The new Gameplay Trailer showcases the chaotic race to the finish at the heart of JETRUNNER. Watch as Nina utilises all of the jetrunning tools at her disposal to navigate perilous tracks in style. Nina's rise to stardom is heightened by the enthusiastic commentary of Mick Acaster (Matthew Mercer), caster of the stars. Shoot, Slide, Swing, and Slam your way to the finish!

Discord |  https://discord.gg/6uqRjPZr 
TikTok |   https://www.tiktok.com/@playjetrunner 
Twitter |  https://x.com/playjetrunner
